title: Validator Verdict v1.0
description: Structured result from the deterministic plan validator. Given the same plan artifact and pinned validator version, output is always identical.

plan_id.description: mission_id from the MIG being validated

validator_version.description: Semver of the validator engine that produced this verdict

result.description: accept only when violations is empty

violations.description: Empty on accept; non-empty on reject

constraint_id.description: Stable identifier for the violated constraint rule (e.g. VIOL-GEOFENCE)

vehicle_id.description: ID of the vehicle involved, or null for mission-level constraints

waypoint_index.description: Zero-based index of the offending waypoint in mig.waypoints, or null
